verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own docs claim dynamic segments that update as subscriber data changes, which covers the 'stay live' part of the story. The evidence does not say which criteria segments can be built from (profile attributes, tags, or behavioral events), so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: documented segment criteria for profile attributes/custom fields, tags, and behavioral events (e.g., opens, clicks, purchases), detailed segmentation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes
